headline: DEFENDER closes the sky pocket — the survival claim is back, and honest this time
lede: Stage 4 of the #3456 arc finished on the board today: a per-death autopsy showed every remaining package loss shared one shape — a hunter on the fighter's own column, where the horizontal laser cannot answer and the climb race is lost 0.5-vs-3. The patrol now breaks the column under an overhead diver and braces across the whole kill box, and the retired survival claim goes back into the copy, pinned to the witness that earned it.

notes.text: DEFENDER s4 (#3496): column-dash + full-box brace — lives spent 46→36 across the 40-seed audit, diedHauling 10→4; two plausible designs were measured and rejected on the record rather than shipped.

The claim 'the patrol survives 20/20 on both audit sets' is re-earned against a mortal pilot — worst seed still bleeds 3 hits, and WITNESS pins copy to measurement so neither can drift without going red.

Resumed-session discipline: the prior slot died right after opening the PR; this session re-verified every claim at the tip before merging — 148/0 node, 41/41 mutants, defenderplay 17/17 twice — and named-and-preserved three untracked debug leftovers from the main checkout instead of deleting them.
Game queue is now empty: DEFENDER's mid-horizon terrain rules go to the QA lane (#3497), ROGUE keeps ~5 honest gaps, and the next lane should re-run idle-kick against the full shelf before choosing.

look.text: The proven patrol, honestly mortal — stage 4 is live
